dataList.content:
♬O water, once it fills it overflows♬
♬水满则溢♬

♬For all lights must go out, the night is still♬
♬华灯灭尽，寂夜长存♬

... It's time.
……是时候了。

... Sharpen your senses.
……都让感官敏锐起来。

Hey, what are some known infiltration routes in this building that our enemies could use?
喂，这栋建筑里有哪些途径可供入侵者利用？

Mm…
嗯……

Anywhere, really. As long as the assassin's willing to put their mind to it.
只要对方打定了主意要来夜袭，从哪里貌似都可以进来。

There was this one time when one of them suddenly appeared from under my bed.
毕竟曾有一次可是从床底下出来的。

That sounds... kinda terrifying...
那……也太可怕了……

Ryōshū, who was leisurely puffing her cigarette as the Sinners were looking around in full alert, suddenly pointed up.
正当大家在警戒着周围时，正在悠闲地抽烟的良秀突然举起了手。

Up.
上。

Ceiling. Someone just landed above us.
有东西落在天花板上的动静。

Ah, so if they're hiding in the ceiling...
啊，如果已经藏在了天花板上……

... There must be more waiting for us just out the door.
那想必房间外也已经有不少人在了。

Hong Lu spoke casually as though he was expecting to have them join us for tea or something.
就仿佛一会与敌人见了面还要打招呼一般，鸿璐淡然地说道。

Impressive... You're pretty sharp.
哎呀……还挺敏锐啊？

The Sinners all whipped around and swung their weapons toward the voice, but...
声音是从房间内部传来的，罪人一齐向那个方向挥动了武器……

... the assassin dodged back with ease and chugged from a gourd in his hand.
但对方轻松地避开攻击、退至后方，随后大口喝下了手中的东西。

Wait, this smells like...
这味道……

Is that sod drinkin' on the job!?
那家伙这会难道还在喝酒！？
